makers.name: Windlass Steelcrafts
makers.specialty: Production swords, military dress blades and historical replicas.
makers.reputation: Has supplied kukris to British Gurkha regiments since 1943.

makers.name: Cold Steel
makers.specialty: Production swords, spears and axes made by overseas suppliers.
makers.reputation: Its historical weapons include designs developed with Dave Baker and Rich McDonald.

makers.name: Deepeeka
makers.specialty: Budget historical weapons, shields and reenactment armour.
makers.reputation: Kult of Athena is its US distributor and carries replicas from antiquity through the modern period.

makers.name: Hanwei
makers.specialty: Production Japanese swords and recent European sword models.
makers.reputation: Paul Chen's sword brand is distributed by CAS Iberia; production changed after the original factory closed in 2025.

makers.name: Regenyei Armory
makers.specialty: HEMA training swords and historical European sword replicas.
makers.reputation: Its Standard Feder is made for HEMA clubs and tournaments.

makers.name: Darksword Armory
makers.specialty: European swords forged from 5160 carbon steel.
makers.reputation: Lists hand-forged Canadian swords based on museum examples.

makers.name: Albion Swords
makers.specialty: European swords designed from museum research.
makers.reputation: Works with sword researcher Peter Johnsson and produced the Royal Armouries I:33 practice sword.

makers.name: Arms & Armor
makers.specialty: Historical European swords, daggers and polearms.
makers.reputation: Makes replicas based on originals in collections including the Wallace Collection.

makers.name: Tod's Workshop / Tod Cutler
makers.specialty: Custom historical crossbows and daggers, plus production Cutler replicas.
makers.reputation: Publishes historical weapon experiments and makes replicas from museum originals.

makers.name: ArmStreet
makers.specialty: Made-to-measure armour and historical costume equipment.
makers.reputation: Its armour catalog targets SCA, WMA and reenactment use.

makers.name: Steel Mastery
makers.specialty: Custom plate armour and full historical harnesses.
makers.reputation: Its Kyiv workshop lists made-to-measure armour and separate interior display suits.

makers.name: Akamatsu Taro / Kimura Swordsmith Workshop
makers.specialty: Signed shinsakuto in self-smelted steel, including Kiyomaro-style katana.
makers.reputation: Kanetsugu and Kanemitsu are named contemporary smiths with sword exhibition awards.

makers.name: Lord of Battles
makers.specialty: Production armour, shields and reenactment equipment.
makers.reputation: Supplies historical armour and costume equipment to film and television productions.

makers.name: Minosaka
makers.specialty: Japanese alloy iaito and sword fittings
makers.reputation: Manufactures iaito and sword fittings in its Kakamigahara workshop.

makers.name: Balaur Arms
makers.reputation: Kult of Athena house brand with swords produced in collaboration with LK Chen.

makers.name: István Tóth
makers.specialty: Traditional Hungarian and other Eurasian horse bows.
makers.reputation: His horse bows are distributed in the United States by exclusive importer Seven Meadows Archery.

makers.name: Adrian Hayes Longbows
makers.specialty: Custom English longbows with laminated wood and bamboo construction.
makers.reputation: Makes longbows individually to the buyer's length and draw weight requirements.
